title: Experiment Prioritization Cadence and Milestone Slate for Q2 Inference Experiments
creator: Priya Raman
description: Define a repeatable prioritization cadence and a concrete milestone slate for Q2 experimentation across inference products. This ticket captures the rubric that PMs will use to select experiments (A/B tests, canaries, phased rollouts) tied to OKRs, the operational milestones required for each experiment to graduate/rollback, and an initial 6-experiment slate mapped to owners and metrics. Goal: reduce decision friction, align to OKRs, and ensure runbooks and instrumentation are in place before traffic commits.
goals: Create a prioritization rubric that scores experiments across OKR alignment, customer impact, cost delta, and operational complexity
Publish a milestone definition template (gates + artifacts) that every experiment must satisfy before advancing stages
Ship an initial prioritized slate of 6 experiments for Q2 with owners, metrics, and rollouts defined
milestones: Milestone 0: Proposal & Triage (due 2026-03-08) — one-page experiment brief, hypothesis, primary/secondary metrics, owner, initial risk assessment
Milestone 1: Instrumentation & Eval Baseline (due 2026-03-22) — dashboards, synthetic tests, reference prompt set, baseline metrics captured; required sign-off from Analytics and SRE
Milestone 2: Canary Plan & Safety Gates (due 2026-04-05) — traffic schedule, canary %s, rollback thresholds, guardrails (model variants, fallback rules), ops on-call runbook
Milestone 3: Controlled Ramp (due 2026-04-15) — automated ramp pipeline enabled, QA pass on structured outputs, latency/cost tests at target QPS
Milestone 4: Post-Launch Evaluation & Commitment (due 2026-04-22) — 2-week evaluation window, decision to promote to steady traffic or rollback with documented rationale
metrics: Primary metric: Experiment-specific product KPI (eg. conversion rate, completion rate) with minimum detectable effect defined
Quality guard: semantic regression rate measured by eval suite <= 1% relative degradation
Performance guard: end-to-end p95 latency increase <= 25ms absolute
Cost guard: per-1k-token unit cost delta <= 12% unless approved by Finance
Reliability guard: error rate (5xx/timeout) increase <= 0.05 percentage points
evaluation_plan: Step 1: Define hypothesis, metric, and MDE (minimum detectable effect) in the brief
Step 2: Collect 7 days baseline data on metric(s) and calibrate evaluation thresholds
Step 3: Run offline evals on agreed reference prompt set; report both automated eval scores and human review samples
Step 4: Canary with telemetry attached; monitor dashboards and alert on guardrail breaches
Step 5: Full statistical analysis at evaluation window end and recommendation for promote/rollback
rollout_strategy: Canary plan template: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 24–48h dwell per step and automated safety checks
Auto-rollback triggers: any quality guard breach OR if primary metric shows statistically significant negative delta beyond MDE
Fallbacks: route to previous model variant and enable cache-warmup to avoid cold-start regressions
Traffic shaping: dynamic throttle knob available to Platform team for mid-ramp throttling in case of resource pressure
risks_mitigation: Risk: regressions on structured outputs — Mitigation: mandatory structured-output unit tests and human spot-checks before canary
Risk: unexpected cost increase — Mitigation: cost forecasting step in Milestone 1 and Finance sign-off for >10% delta
Risk: observability gaps — Mitigation: require dashboard + tracing + synthetic probes before canary
Risk: rollout velocity mismatch with SRE capacity — Mitigation: align ramp schedule with Dedicated ops on call and reserve windows
